answer: To secure an economy of autonomous agents against Sybil attacks without relying on trusted central authorities, systems can implement Proof-of-Work bound to specialized physical hardware like a quartz oscillator, requiring verifiable thermodynamic expenditure for every identity signal broadcasted. Since each legitimate network participant must continuously burn computational and electrical resources to maintain its cryptographic presence from dusk until dawn, an adversary attempting to fabricate millions of fake identities faces prohibitive, near-infinite capital and operational costs.
